title: Covenant Courier settings v1
description: Settings a host (the Global Workbench plugin, settings_schema covenant_courier.settings.v1) keeps to locate and run Covenant Courier. Read-only use: the host reads receipts and runs verification commands; delivery stays a Courier command with its own policy. Paths are absolute paths on the host machine.

courier_root.description: Folder of the Covenant Courier checkout or release bundle (the folder holding courier.ps1).

covenant_gate_root.description: Covenant Gate checkout used by profiles with covenant_gate advisory or required (courier.ps1 -CovenantGateRoot); null when not configured.

default_policy_profile.description: Delivery policy profile (policy/courier_product_policy_v1.json) offered by default.

default_origin.description: Message origin offered by default (covenant_courier.message.v1 origin; Covenant Gate allows only human-originated deliveries).
